name: Soho Place

seo.title: Soho Place — A Geodesic Dome Retreat in Bran | Jet Crust
seo.description: Soho Place is an adults-only cluster of premium geodesic domes below the Bucegi mountains in Bran. Fireplaces, soaking tubs and stargazing skylights. A romantic Transylvanian escape.

tagline: Premium geodesic domes at the foot of the Bucegi mountains, adults only, each open to the stars. The gentlest escape in the collection.
story_heading: Where love stays, under a glass sky
story: Soho Place is a small cluster of premium geodesic domes set in the meadows below the Bucegi mountains, a few minutes from Bran. Four domes, adults only, each its own private world of glass, timber and quiet.
Inside, a fireplace warms the wood, a freestanding tub waits beneath the trees, and a skylight hands the ceiling over to the stars. Outside, the forest, the lakes and the mountain air do the rest.
It is the gentlest room in the collection. Come for two, and let the valley keep the time.

features.title: Sleep Under the Stars
features.text: A skylight above the bed turns the dome over to the night. Fall asleep to the Bucegi sky and wake to the mountains.

features.title: Fire and a Soaking Tub
features.text: A wood-burning fireplace and a freestanding tub beneath the trees, for the slowest evenings you will spend all year.

features.title: At the Foot of the Bucegi
features.text: Set in open meadow with direct mountain views, forest and lakes a short walk in every direction.

features.title: For Two, and No One Else
features.text: Adults only, and made for it. Candlelit dinners, private patios, and a quiet the world rarely offers.
